**Ground vs body drag.** The body-drag asset (section 3a) reuses the base ground numbers and adds a backward strafe scale of 0.35. It drops the sprint block timers (`BlockSprintTime`, `BlockTacSprintTime`) and the prone feet check. Body dragging is therefore not a separate speed model. It is the ground model with a different input map and different rules around sprinting.

**Falling and parachute.** Landing damage comes from a curve keyed by impact speed (`CRV_LandingPunishment_Damage`, `CRV_ParachutePunishment_Damage`). Air control and push-off are set per surface angle (`CRF_Falling_SurfaceAngleToAirControl`, `..._PushOffForce`).

The **pull** curve gives the magnetic pull toward a target by distance. It is zero at close range, reaches full within 200 on ADS curves (600 on Default), and falls off at long range.
The **slow** curve reduces aim speed near a target. It reaches full later than the pull curve on ADS (4000 against 200).
The **reticle edge** falloff weights the assist as the target drifts toward the reticle edge.
The **target weight** scales each target's contribution.
**Weapon mapping.** How a weapon maps to a curve family (AR, LMG and so on) is in the weapon data, not here.
**Curve tangents.** Only key time and value are summarised. Tangents and interpolation modes were not reported.

Roll reads E and Q as a single 1-axis value.

Nothing in this document was verified against live gameplay or the running UI.

**Health and fuel:** the airplane starts at 150 health. Threshold triggers sit at 90% (main health) and 90/50/0% (fuel tank). Three fuel-leak effects exist (0.1, 0.4, 0.5 per second). The export does not say which threshold drives which leak, and the threshold triggers have no above-threshold effects attached.
**Parachute and camera numbers are separate systems:** the camera spring arms (section 6) are per-weapon and do not feed flight.
**Units not stated** for velocity maps, the SpeedFOV x-axis, air density, drag areas, and several curve inputs. Values are given as exported.
**Assist and control graph.** The `BHRotaryMovementControl` assist bodies (PID, damping, smoothed influence) are present as sub-objects but only their labels and top-level modes were summarised.
**Shared curves.** The collision and damage-multiplier curves are exported with no input-unit suffix; their meaning is inferred from the names.

**Explosion sequence:** a sequence (section 3) fires each entry's recipe at its `Timing` (seconds) with its `RootOffset` added to the sequence origin. The entries are not sorted by time in the file (the 155mm sequence lists every entry at t = 0.0), so each entry's `Timing` value, not its list position, sets when it fires.

**Post-process:** each row's progress curves drive their parameters over the row's `Duration`. `ParameterValuesOnEffectApplication` is set when the effect starts and `OnRemoveParameterValues` is set when it ends. A row with `Duration = 0` does not time out and must be removed by the gameplay side.
**Impacts:** the physical material is chosen by the surface the bullet hits. The caliber bucket (small/medium/large) then scales the impact size within the random range.
**Material and decal assets not opened.** `MI_*`, `MM_*`, and `MI_Decal_*` paths are listed but their parameters are not in this category.
**Post-process UI tags.** The row tags (for example `PostProcessEffect.DamageType.Fall`) are shown in the table, but how the gameplay side selects a row by damage type is not in this category.

**Focus energy (SKS, Judge):** `FocusEnergyReductionPerShot` and `RecoilReductionWhenFocussing` are per-shot values. `NoFocusEnergySpeedMultiplier` is probably a sway-speed scalar used when focus is empty. Neither is confirmed.
`IronSightsAimTime = 50,000` on the tank barrel and `WeaponAccuracy = 70 MOA` look like placeholders or unused tuning. The export gives no way to check.
Input mapping contexts are shown only for their first key per action. Secondary keys and gamepad alternates are summarised, not listed in full.
